translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: LUK
book.title: LUK Luk ere basem Tuma Yenbo. Kiyi late tuma.

content: Jisas ere tame ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes keyem (12-pela) emne yaku newom.

Jisas ere eri ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes keyem (12-pela) anepoi tame emne won yam, ere emne etep wom. An kemne mure newote, kem gabo nogwape kuyese pekeroukte, let nai tewo nai tatame emne kuyese eyarte. Etep wom.
Newom, ere emne God eri kom panen si tuma wusoute, let nai tewo nai tame emne yenbo nente won yite wom.
Yite wom, ere emne etep wom. Kem wos mane sen yite. Kem kwokwul mane sogwunen yite. Ayer mane peleikte. Awos, kel mane kir peten sen yite. Tame oub pes mane sen yite.
Ma komke kem yite, eme kemne emri akek panen yite, kem eteri akewouke yin temente. Kem akeite akeite akek mane yite.

Ma komke kem yite, eme kemne yaper nente, kem ete kom mesginin yite. Yite, kem tewo subu etek nubutkwunte. Ete komri tatame eme etep lan, eme etep abote. O nema emne yaperke nenye, eke yuri God ere nemne yaper awosein nente nenbe.
Etep womke, eri anepoi tame eme kom komke yin God eri tuma yenbo wusowun, sewurbetem, let nai tewo nai tatame emne yenbo nenen sewurbetem.
Herot ere abom. Jisas ere eike?
Apeilake Herot ere Jisas eri nenbetemkap metem, ere ep abon ep abom. Tame kau eme etep wobetem. Baptais ok wirubetem tame, Jon, ere selek sene wayem, ere mure peten, ere eke rigrabe nenbe.
Kau eme etep wobetem. Elaija ere selek sene wayem, ere ete rigrabe nenbe. Kau eme etep wobetem. Kiyi temenem tuma wusoubetem tame etemri wuri ere sene wayem, ere eke rigrabe nenbe.
Etep wobetem, Herot ere etep wom. An metbe, tame wuri ere rigrabe nenbe. Kap ere eike? Ere Jon berai. Jon erne an kiyi wak regem. Etep wom, ere Jisas erne late abom.
Jisas ere tame nogwape (500) emne a newon am.
Jisas ere won yim tame eme sene yan emri nenbetem nogwape woskap eme Jisas erne wusowum. Wusowum, ere emne panen etemwou Betsaida komke yim.
Yim, tatame eme etep metem, eme erne semowun yim. Yim, Jisas ere etep lam, ere emne metekwasen, ere emne God eri kom panen siten tuma yenbo wusoubetem, ere let nai tewo nai tatame emne eyarbetem.

Eyarbetem, perpe yabel warbetem, Jisas eri ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes keyem (12-pela) anepoi tame eme yan erne etep wom. Nemri tetan emi gwo e tameken berai. Ne tatame emne won eme kom komke yin awos peten an etek tuknate.

Jisas ere emne etep wom. Kerem, kem emne awos newon ate. Etep womke, eme erne awosein etep wom. Nema a berai. Nema geil ep yekwo let omyen sok peswouke tetan. Ne mapeke abobe? Nema yin tatame nogwape emne a tukte o? Eme etep wom.
Tame nogwapewai (500) eme temenem, Jisas ere anepoi tame emne etep wom. Kem emne wote, eme nogwape nogwape kenakena (50 50ke) site. Etep wom.
Eri anepoi tame eme tatame nogwape emne etepke won sim.

Simke, Jisas ere geilken omyen sokken peten sen ere le nelke niru lan God erne pir wom. Pir wom, ere geilken omyen sokken pekayewon eri anepoi tame emne newom. Newom, eme peten tatame nogwape emne newopit peteyam.
Newopit peteyam, eme an se kir tem, a tep anepoi tame eme peten kwora sare ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes keyem (12-pela) etek yewon pelawon yam.
Pita ere Jisas erne etep wom. Ne Krais, God eter won yam tame.
Yuri Jisas ere kena wiwi God erken tuma namdebetem, eri anepoi tame eme eterken temenem, ere emne etep wom. Tatame nogwape eme ane mapeke wobe, an eike?

Eme erne awosein etep wom. Kau eme etepke wobe. Ne tatame emne baptais ok wirubetem tame Jon. Kau eme nene etep wobe. Ne kiyi temenem tuma wusoubetem tame Elaija. Kau eme nene etepke wobe. Ne God eri kiyi temenem tuma wusoubetem tame etemri wuri, ne selek sene wayem.
Ere emne etep wom. Kerem, kem ane mapeke wote, an eike? Pita ere awosein etep wom. Ne Krais, God eter nene won yam tame. Etep wom.
Jisas ere wom. An sate, an sene wayen yite.
Ere etep womke, Jisas ere emne wotaken emne etep wom. Pita eri woye tuma kem tatame emne mane wote.

Ere emne sene etep wom. An Tatame Etemne Lan Yeirim Tame, an mus eisau nogwape mette nenbe. Juda etemri apeilake tameken God eri akek yaku kerebetem tameken emri apeilake Moses eri wule tuma wusoubetem tameken eme ane magel taite, eme ane pen sate nenbe. Yabel pes tete, mur wote, God ere ane wote, an wou sene peten sene wayen yite nenbe.

Etep wom, ere anepoi tame akei emne etep wom. Eike tame eme arenken anepoi yite, eme gwopke tete. Eme maime teitkwunte. Ari mette muskap eme kwokwos kwokwos kir etep sete. Eme etep tete, eme arenken yite.
Tame eme emri maime wusomwou abote, eme yaper tete nenbe. Tame eme arenwoune kenawaike abote, eme maime wusom beke abo, yuri eme yenbo som temente nenbe.
Tame eme nogwape nowselri woswou pette abobe, yuri eme yaper temente, etepkap e yenbo o? Berai. E yaper.

Tatame eike eme ane sebera yate, ari tuma kir sebera yate, yuri Tatame Etemne Lan Yeirim Tame, ere sene yate, ere ete tatame emne awosein sebera yate, emne kobo beke kip la. Ere yate, ere Apei eteri mureken God eri kom tame etemri mureken yate nenbe.
An kemne sekenke wobe. Gwotepte gwotek tetan tatame kau eme beke sa, eme late, God ere kom panen site yabel tete nenbe. Jisas ere etep wom.
Jisas eri wusom kaspem.
Sande wuri temke, Jisas ere Pita, Jon, Jems emne panen kowke God erken tuma namdete yawom.
Yawom, ere tuma namdebetem, eri bitimi kaspem, epkapke lam. Lam, eri warmenem tame oub ere kaspen geipasubuwai tem.
Jisas ere etek temenem, agetage kiyi temenem tame pes, Mosesken Elaijaken, epe yan Jisas erken tuma namdebetem.

Namdebetem, God eteri mureken yan, epe Jisas eterken God eri kiyi wom tuma namdebetem. Kiyi God ere etep wom. Jisas ere Jerusalem komke sate nenbe. Eme sene etepke namdebetem. Kerake tete, Jisas ere Jerusalemke sate.
Etepke namdebetem, Pitaken anepoi tame pesken eme tuknamenem, eme sene wayen sin lam, Jisas eri wus kaspen epkap lam, tame pes epe eterken yan tetemenem.

Yan temenem, epe sene mesginin yite wom, Pita ere Jisas erne etep wom. Aneyen, nerem gwotek tetan, e yenbowai. Nema ake mur kerete. Wuri nereri, wuri Moses eteri, wuri Elaija eteri. Ere etep bepou me wom.
Etep wobetem, nel gwan ere emne yan subbetem, eme me akem.
Eme akemke, tuma wuri ete nel gwan borke etep wom. Ete tame ere areri Yen yenbo adebas. An erne won yam. Kem eri tuma mette.
Etep wobetemke, eme lam, Jisas ere kena wiwi eterwou tetmenem. Tetmenem, eri anepoi tame eme tuma rebe tem, emri lam wos eme akeite tame emne beke wusou.
Jisas ere gabo yaper erne pekeroukum.
Kwokwos eme kow mesginin yeirim, tatame nogwape eme yan Jisas erne keluke yan lam.
Yan lam, tatame nogwape etemri tame wuri ere worworke etep wom. Tuma wusoube tame, an nene worworke wobe. Ne ari taureyen late, ere ari yen wurisubuwai.
Gabo yaper erne guleleten, ere taye pitbe, erne tubanepitin san tuknabe. Ere elemoi sabelekwo bulbalken worabe. Gabo ere eri wusom yaper nenbe, ere erne beke mesgin.
An neri anepoi emne wometye, eme pekerouklawoiwo.

Jisas ere emne awosein etep wom. Oi, gwopte tetan tatame nogwape kem kenawaike beke abo. Kem porere yenbo berai. Yabel nogwape an keremken tetan. Mapeke kem ane kenawaike abote? An kera moke wobe. Sene ere ar erne etep wom. Neri yen ne erne panen yate.
Panen yabetem, gabo ere yen erne tubanepitim. Tubanepitim, Jisas ere gabo erne womke, ere yen erne mesginin yim. Yim, Jisas ere yen erne yenbo nenen, ere ar eteri letke sene newom.

Etep womke, tatame nogwape eme God eri mure etep lam, eme wouken akem. Jisas ere tewo wurinabu sene etep wom. An sate, an sene wayen yite. (Matyu 17:22-23; Mak 9:30-32) Eme Jisas eri nenbetem wule som wouken akbetem, Jisas ere eri anepoi tame emne etep wom.
Ari wote tuma kem mane wan gette. An Tatame Etemne Lan Yeirim Tame, tame eme ane keresukte nenbe.
Etep wom, tuma eri somo eme beke met, eme erne tuma somo womette me akem. Eme tuma somo mette wurken, eke God ere emri porere wotakem.
Eike apeilake eisau?
Jisas eri anepoi tame eme tuma walekap nayin etep wom. Neremri wuri eike ere apeilake eisau? Etep wom.
Jisas ere emri porere lam, eke ere yen nebule wuri peten eteri ganke teteruwum.

Teteruwun, ere emne etep wom. Tatame eme ane kenawaike abote, eme gwotek tetan yenkap erne pap yewobe, eme arene kir pap yewobe. Ane pap yewobe tatame eme ane won yam tame, God, eterne kir pap yewobe. Keremri sig nebuleken tatame etem eme apeilake eisau tete. Jisas ere etep wom.
Eike keremri peiktame berai, eme keremri tamenowu.
Jon ere Jisas erne etep wom. Aneyen, nema lam, tame wuri ere neri sig wom, ere nereri murek gabo pekeroukem. Ere neremri tamesip berai, eke nema erne wotakem.
Jisas ere erne awosein etep wom. Kem erne mane wotakete. Tame eme keremne yaper beke nen, ete tame eme keremri tamenowu. Jisas ere emne etep wom.
Samaria komri tatame eme Jisas erne magel tayem.
Jisas ere Hevenke yite yabel mekin mekin tem, ere porere wurisubu tem, ere Jerusalemke yite wom.
Etep wom, ere tame kau emne won eme taresin yim, eme Samaria distrikri komke yin wurim, eme eri tukna akeken awosken eyarte wurim.
Wurim, Samaria tatame eme Juda tatame etemri peiktame temenem. Eme metem, ere Juda tame etemri kom Jerusalemke yibetem, eme erne pap beke yewo, eme erne wotakem.
Wotakem, anepoi tame pes, Jemsken Jonken, epe etep lan, epe Jisas erne etep wom. Aneyen, ne mapeke abobe? Nesa ker won Hevenke yeirin tatame emne kerke eite o?
Etep womke, Jisas ere epne petkwo lan epne kuken won, wotakem.
Wotaken sene eme akeite komke yim.
Tame ere Jisas erne semowun yite wom.
Eme keluke yibetem, tame wuri ere Jisas erne etep wom. Ne mak yi mak yite, an nerenken kir yite.
Jisas ere erne etep wom. Boulke sewurbe mou wale eme sel purik tuknabe. Ap eme neiske tuknabe. Aren, an Tatame Etemne Lan Yeirim Tame, an tukna akeken berai,
Etep won ere akeite tame wuri erne etep wom. Ne arenken yite. Ete tame ere awosein etep wom. Wai. Ne kir wote, an ari apei erne kiyi sele meike rasen an nerenke ek yite.

Jisas ere erne awosein etep wom. Ne mane yin erne sele meike raste. Arene kenawaike beke abo tatame eme sabe tamekap. Ete tame etem eme saye tame erne sele meike raste. Ne yin God eri kom panen site tuma wusoute. Etep wom.
Sene akeite tame wuri ere erne etep wom. Aneyen, an nerenken yite. Ne kir tete, an sene yin kom tame emne pir won emne nar peten tak keren mesginin, nerenken ek yite.
Jisas ere erne etep wom. Tame eme pere berei kerete, eme kelu kiyi beke lan yi, eme God eter panen site kom yaku kuyese beke kip kere. Ere emne etep wom.
